current.text: Wells is projected to come off the bench, possibly as the first reserve, for about 20 to 25 minutes a game.
The projected Memphis starters are Ty Jerome, Cedric Coward, Jerami Grant, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey.
Memphis is expected to use an 11 or 12 man rotation. Only Boozer and Coward are expected to play more than 30 minutes, which caps the bench's minutes.
Probably not even a 16-team player. A rank in the 200s is about right, and Yahoo and ESPN ADP should be ignored.
Memphis has the maximum 4-4-4 schedule in weeks 19 to 21 for a March 28 end. It has only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: Poor fantasy profile: few rebounds, assists, steals and blocks, and weak shooting percentages.
He lacks athleticism and scores inconsistently, but he is a sturdy defender.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo plays at a very high pace and uses short, hard stints of about five minutes. He keeps players' minutes down.

note: Wells is not a draft target in our 144-player auction. Yahoo ranks him 175 and ESPN 230, both price him at 0 USD, and the expert says even 16-team leagues can skip him. His projected 44% FG with few rebounds, assists and blocks gives no build a reason to take him, and a bench role of 20 to 25 minutes in an 11 or 12 man rotation caps his volume. Early in the season, only watch whether an injury in front of him pushes his minutes clearly above that range.
